16e5c27ae8eb4b42.title: Jess & Joe - Studio Cabaret
16e5c27ae8eb4b42.desc: After more than a decade of dazzling audiences around the globe, Jessica Hayes and Joseph Ott bring their powerhouse talents together for an unforgettable evening in TOCA’s intimate Studio Cabaret. When these two acclaimed performers found love, they also discovered a remarkable musical chemistry. The result? A delightful collection of original songs that blend the storytelling charm of contemporary musical theatre with clever wit, sparkling harmonies, and just the right touch of playful irreverence. Their music is heartfelt without being heavy, humorous without being silly, and filled with the kind of rich vocal harmonies that only seasoned performers can deliver. Expect toe-tapping melodies, laugh-out-loud lyrics, and tender moments that remind us why live music matters. Up close and personal in the Studio Cabaret, this is an evening of warmth, joy, and world-class musicianship that will leave you smiling long after the final note. Join us for a night of laughter, love, and songs that just might save the world.

It's been over a year since this cast hit the road, and we know: a lot has happened. With the midterms on the horizon and the political circus showing no signs of slowing down, there has never been a more necessary or more hilarious time to laugh through the chaos together.
